purpose: Increase practical-screened supply with meaningful compact compounds/fusions. Use cheap .com availability early only to allocate screening time; availability never substitutes for identity, trademark or Owner quality judgment.
owner_label_policy: Owner feedback is the authoritative subjective label. Controller triage only prevents obvious low-value/risk material from consuming Owner attention; no independent 'excellent' threshold exists.
sequence: intrinsic sanity check -> bulk exact .com observation -> identity/public-risk screening only for direct-available or unusually strong hold candidates -> practical-screened pool
